title: The body and health
theme: body parts, injuries, illness and symptoms
goal: Recognise and use 22 words for the body, injuries, illness and symptoms.

example.fr: Il a tapé du poing sur la table.
example.en: He banged his fist on the table.

example.fr: J'ai mal aux muscles après le sport.
example.en: My muscles ache after exercise.

example.fr: Le cœur est un organe vital.
example.en: The heart is a vital organ.

example.fr: Il s'est cassé une côte en tombant en ski.
example.en: He broke a rib falling while skiing.

example.fr: Prenez une grande respiration.
example.en: Take a deep breath.

items.note: Also: Inspirez profondément = breathe in deeply.

example.fr: C'est une maladie génétique rare.
example.en: It's a rare genetic disease.

example.fr: Le diabète est une maladie fréquente.
example.en: Diabetes is a common disease.

example.fr: Il faut nettoyer la plaie avant de mettre un pansement.
example.en: You need to clean the wound before putting on a bandage.

example.fr: J'ai une cicatrice au genou depuis mon accident de vélo.
example.en: I have had a scar on my knee since my bike accident.

example.fr: Heureusement, la tumeur n'était pas grave.
example.en: Luckily, the tumour wasn't serious.

example.fr: Le vaccin donne une bonne immunité.
example.en: The vaccine gives good immunity.

example.fr: L'élève s'est senti mal et il est allé à l'infirmerie.
example.en: The student felt sick and went to the sick room.

example.fr: Mettez deux gouttes dans chaque œil.
example.en: Put two drops in each eye.

example.fr: Mon épaule est encore douloureuse.
example.en: My shoulder is still painful.

example.fr: Mon grand-père est un peu sourd ; parle plus fort.
example.en: My grandfather is a bit deaf; speak louder.

example.fr: Il ne boit pas d'alcool : il est sobre depuis cinq ans.
example.en: He doesn't drink alcohol: he has been sober for five years.

example.fr: Je me suis coupé, ça saigne !
example.en: I cut myself, it's bleeding!

example.fr: Le bébé a vomi toute la nuit.
example.en: The baby threw up all night.

example.fr: J'ai du mal à avaler les pilules.
example.en: I find it hard to swallow pills.

example.fr: Attention, ce chien mord !
example.en: Careful, this dog bites!

example.fr: Une guêpe m'a piqué au bras.
example.en: A wasp stung me on the arm.

items.note: Also informal: to steal (piquer un portefeuille).

items.en: to look well, to look healthy

example.fr: Tu as bonne mine ! Tu as passé de bonnes vacances ?
example.en: You look well! Did you have a good holiday?

items.note: avoir mauvaise mine = to look unwell

blocks.title: Usage tips
blocks.body:
- [[Une côte]] is a rib and also a coast; [[un côté]] is a side.
- [[Ça saigne]], [[ça pique]]: use [[ça]] for symptoms.
- [[Mordre]] is like [[vendre]]: il mord, il a mordu.
- [[Sobre]] also means *plain*: [[une robe sobre]].
- Québec: [[se faire piquer par un maringouin]] = to get a mosquito bite.

blocks.title: Listen and repeat
blocks.note: Repeat each sentence out loud, then record yourself and compare.

steps.intro: Answer without scrolling back. Getting something wrong now helps you remember it later.

blocks.prompt: Match the body and health words.
The nurse wants you to breathe in deeply. She says:
blocks.explain: [[Prendre une grande respiration]] = to take a deep breath.

blocks.prompt: A bee has just stung Mei. What does she say?

blocks.text: Tu as bonne ___ aujourd'hui ! Tu as bien dormi ?
blocks.en: You look well today! Did you sleep well?
blocks.explain: [[Avoir bonne mine]] = to look healthy and rested.
[[Cicatrice]] = si-ca-trice: the first c sounds like s (before i), the second like k (before a).

blocks.fr: Mon grand-père est un peu sourd ; parle plus fort.
blocks.en: My grandfather is a bit deaf; speak louder.

summary:
- Name parts of the body: [[poing, muscle, côte, organe]]
- Describe injuries and illness: [[plaie, cicatrice, maladie, douloureux]]
- Say what happens to the body: [[saigner, vomir, avaler, mordre, piquer]]
